sentences.text:
OFFICE No. NOTE 01. 04.09.2025 TRR,J  It is the contention of the learned counsel for  the petitioners that without considering the  objections raised by the petitioners, the  respondents are trying to demolish the petitioners'
modern sheep farming facility which was constructed in Survey No.125/1, 125/2, 125/4 and 125/5 situated in Tekulodu Village, Chilamathur Mandal, Sri Satya Sai District, in pursuance of the notification dated 28.05.2025 issued under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No.30 of 2013).
As the respodnents are trying to dispossess the petitioners from the subject property without considering the objections raised by the petitioners, there shall be interim direction as prayed for.
List the mater after four weeks, to secure instructions by the learned Assistant Government Pleader.
